title: Grade 9 Chemistry National Exam & Practice 2018 (7 Chapters Combined)
description: Comprehensive examination bank combining 7 chapters (12 questions). Official Ethiopian national curriculum.

questions.questionText: Which branch of chemistry deals about the effect and fate of chemical productions in the surrounding?
questions.explanation: Environmental chemistry studies the behavior and effects of chemicals in air, water, soil, and living systems.

questions.questionText:
Consider the following diagram:

Which element in the periodic table is represented by the above electronic configuration diagram?
How many protons and electrons are found in an atom of argon (Ar) with atomic number 18 and mass number 40, respectively?
questions.explanation: Atomic number 18 means 18 protons. A neutral atom has equal protons and electrons, so it has 18 electrons.

questions.questionText: According to Mendeleev's periodic law, which of the following determines the properties of elements?
questions.explanation: Mendeleev's periodic law states that the properties of elements are periodic functions of their atomic weights.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statement is CORRECT about periods in the modern periodic table?
options: They are vertical columns of elements in the periodic table.
There are seven periods in the periodic table of elements.
The first three periods in the periodic table are known as long periods.
They start with alkali metals and end with alkaline earth metals.
questions.explanation: Periods are horizontal rows, and the modern periodic table has 7 periods.

questions.questionText: Why does atomic radius increase when we go down the group in the periodic table? This is because
questions.explanation: Moving down a group adds electron shells, increasing the distance of valence electrons from the nucleus.

questions.questionText: A certain element has atomic number of 33 and mass number of 75. What is the position of this element in the modern Periodic Table?
questions.explanation: Z = 33 is arsenic, with configuration [Ar] 3d¹⁰4s²4p³. Therefore, it belongs to the p-block.

To which one of the following do the elements Li to Ne belong? They are in the same
questions.explanation: Li through Ne occupy the same horizontal row, so they are all in Period 2.

questions.questionText: In which one of the following conditions, does an ion formed from an atom?
options: When the number of electrons in an atom are less than number of protons.
When the number of electrons in an atom are equal with number of protons.
When the number of neutrons in an atom are equal with number of protons.
When the number of neutrons in an atom are greater than number of protons.
questions.explanation:
An ion forms when electrons are gained or lost.

 If electrons < protons, the atom becomes a positive ion (cation).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is TRUE about masses of subatomic particles?
options: The mass of an atom is equally distributed throughout its space.
The three subatomic particles are equal in their absolute masses.
The relative mass of a neutron is greater than that of an electron.
The relative mass of a neutron is equal with that of an electron.
questions.explanation:
A neutron has relative mass ≈ 1, while an electron has relative mass ≈ 1/1836.
 Therefore, a neutron is much heavier.

Which of the following bond formations is represented by the above diagram?
questions.explanation: An electron is transferred from one atom to another, forming oppositely charged ions. Their electrostatic attraction forms an ionic bond.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an example of a covalent molecule?
questions.explanation: HBr consists of two non-metals sharing electrons, forming a polar covalent molecule.
